name: Jellyfin Oscars
description: Jellyfin server plugin that enriches movie metadata with Oscar (Academy Awards) information.
overview: Adds Oscar metadata, badges, and optional collections to Jellyfin movies.

versions.changelog: Add async manual scan, batch-based scanning with persistent progress, scan concurrency protection, improved structured logging and OMDb diagnostics, collection poster support, badge text fix (Oscar Nominee), and optional JavaScript Injector auto-registration.
